xBRIEFInfo.description: Scope xBRIEF: triage Phase 3 operator brief + triage:show --format=operator

plan.title: feat(skills,triage): Phase 3 operator brief contract + triage:show --format=operator

narratives.Description: deft-directive-triage Phase 3 requires decision menus but does not contract an operator-facing candidate brief before each decision, so agents can ship menu-only or chip-only turns. This story adds a Phase 3 brief + same-turn rule, host structured-question adapter, Phase 2.3 disambiguation, and triage:show --format=operator mechanical assist.
narratives.Overview: Standalone triage judgment-surface quality fix from statusreport dogfood; not OpenClaw-only.
narratives.UserStory: As a triage operator, I want every Phase 3 decision to show a same-turn candidate brief with lean before the menu, so that structured-question hosts cannot reduce triage to chip-only verb dispatch.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Step 1: Edit content/skills/deft-directive-triage/SKILL.md Phase 3 with ! operator brief fields, same-turn rule, host ask_user/chips adapter, and Phase 2.3 cross-link that queue non-annotation does not forbid Phase 3 briefs. Step 2: Implement triage:show --format=operator (or equivalent) in packages/core triage show module and CLI/task wiring so pasteable brief comes from cache files. Step 3: Unit tests for operator format renderer and skill content-contract markers. Step 4: CHANGELOG [Unreleased] cites #2890. Verification: run targeted unit tests for triage show operator format and skill contract tests; task check:merge before push.
narratives.Traces: Acceptance maps to #2890 A–E; missing_traces_justification until implementation maps line numbers.

items.title: Phase 3 requires operator brief before decision menu

narrative.Acceptance: Given Phase 3 per-item decision, when skill is followed, then agent presents issue id/title/link, labels, 2-5 line summary, AC or thin-body note, and lean+why before or with the menu; menu-only/chip-only without brief is forbidden.

items.title: Brief and menu same operator-visible turn

narrative.Acceptance: Given Phase 3 decision UI, when presented, then brief and menu share one operator-visible message/surface; brief-only then later chip-only without restating brief is forbidden.
Given chips/ask_user hosts, when skill is read, then prose brief stays in chat, options are actions only, option labels do not substitute for brief, and OpenClaw ask_user is named as example.
Given skill Phase 2.3 and Phase 3, when read, then queue non-annotation rule does not forbid Phase 3 operator briefs/leans and cross-links make that explicit.

Given cache-backed triage:show, when --format=operator runs, then pasteable brief includes title link labels summary AC excerpt latest decision active-xBRIEF flag; skill SHOULD prefer it as backbone; tests and CHANGELOG cite #2890.
